【中国北方面食硬核派 · 第4集/共4集 · 烩（完结）】
河南烩面：一片抹了油的面，下锅前两手一扯，越扯越宽，像条宽带。但秘密全在那锅汤——羊骨劈开露出骨髓，熬足八个钟头，汤白得像牛奶。面片、羊肉、粉丝、木耳一锅烩。1947年郑州“合记”首推白汤烩面，从员工伙食做成一座城的名片。一碗烩面，河南人的面子与里子。

Henan hui mian (braised noodles): an oiled sheet of dough is pulled wide by two hands right before it hits the pot — wider and wider, like a belt. But the secret is the broth: lamb bones are split for the marrow and simmered a full eight hours until the soup turns milk-white. Noodles, lamb, vermicelli and wood-ear go in together. In 1947 Zhengzhou’s “He Ji” first served white-broth hui mian, turning a staff meal into a city’s calling card.
